answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 14527 Country: India Title: Asalamu Alikum I have a one younger sister and few years back while in her school, we got ring from her school that due to some health problems she has been shifted to hospital. The doctors in hospital told tht she is ok and when we returned back home, she started acting voilent. ultimately she revealed to my grandmother that i am jinn and i want a chicken to be sacrificed then i will leave her. we acted like wise and where we slaughtered chicken on tht blood my sister wrote the initial letter of the name of jinn. we took her to one peer baba and their the jinn appeared and the jinn begged a pardon. Now after few years we feel that the jinn again visit her as she acts like the way she acted earlier. her actions are different, her eye movements are different. Pls guide me wht i need to do. I m very sad about the situation Kindly reply Question: Asalamu Alikum I have a one younger sister and few years back while in her school, we got ring from her school that due to some health problems she has been shifted to hospital. The doctors in hospital told tht she is ok and when we returned back home, she started acting voilent. ultimately she revealed to my grandmother that i am jinn and i want a chicken to be sacrificed then i will leave her. we acted like wise and where we slaughtered chicken on tht blood my sister wrote the initial letter of the name of jinn. we took her to one peer baba and their the jinn appeared and the jinn begged a pardon. Now after few years we feel that the jinn again visit her as she acts like the way she acted earlier. her actions are different, her eye movements are different. Pls guide me wht i need to do. I m very sad about the situation Kindly reply Answer ID: 14527 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1531/1219=H/1430) You should not go to any baba etc. This thing sometimes happens due to disorder in menstrual cycle and delay in marriage. Therefore, you should pay exclusive attention to same and consult any expert hakim . You should recite Surah Fatihah after every salah seven times with durood seven times before and after, and give your sister to drink. Also, ask your sister (patient) to recite the same, blow on her hands and spread over the body. She should do the same while going to bed in the state wudhu sitting on a clean bed, and pay attention to recite the duas of sleeping and waking up according to Sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
